jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary
Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the operations of a specific plant or production facility. Duties include managing production schedules, ensuring quality control standards are met, optimizing production processes, managing plant personnel, and ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations. Develops and implements strategies to improve plant efficiency, reduce costs, and increase productivity. Collaborates with other departments to meet production goals and objectives. May also be responsible for budgeting, forecasting, and reporting on plant performance.

Essential Functions
• Must be able to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
• Ensure that production levels are at an optimum with minimum plant downtime. Coordinate by-size production with sales market demands and long range planning.
• Work closely with the quality control technicians to ensure that all production meet the customers needs.
• Proper utilization and maintenance of all stationary and mobile equipment so that equipment cost and downtime are minimized and the equipment is available when needed.
• Participates in developing an annual operating budget which includes production volume and capital improvements.
• Responsible for ensuring that the site meets or exceeds operating budget.
• Works with sales on identification and elimination of customer issues and concerns to improve customer satisfaction and relations.
• Works on the implementation of cost saving programs and/or continuous improvement activities to reduce costs and improve operating efficiency.
• Manages daily production meetings on the daily running and operations of the plant.
• Be proactive in the safety of all personnel and activities in the plant area. Inspect and maintain dust control systems to ensure a healthy work environment.
• Be knowledgeable of waste products, their impact on the environment and their proper disposal.
• Works with SHE Regional employees and Company officials to promote a safe work environment that meets all State and Federal rules and regulations.
• Maintain proper levels of inventories to support local sales activities and long range market demands.
• Work closely with the QC Technician onsite to ensure we maintain consistency in the quality of our products and services to the customer.
• Works closely with Sales staff and customers to ensure that products meet customer needs and expectations.
• Manage financial decisions for the plant, including budgets, forecasts, inventory management, and labor and capital planning to ensure adherence to all budgets and financial goals.
• Seek improvement activities to reduce costs and improve operating efficiency across the plant.
• Initiates action for environmental permits and prepares reports for various public agencies and coordinates with Legal Department or outside legal counsel or regulating agencies on compliance issues.
• Utilizes appropriate resources and recommendations in community relations and legislative efforts and actively participates in the area’s community outreach and educational programs.
• Provide an example of good leadership, keep open, an effective lines of communication with division staff and plant level personnel.
• Provides coaching and disciplinary counseling to employees under his or her area of responsibility (includes employee relations and administration of collective bargaining agreements region specific).
• Identifies, assesses, prioritizes, and resolves production and employee related problems.
• Manages and supervises activities of hourly production and maintenance employees.
• Approves the selection, hiring, training, change of status and separation of employees.
• Insures that employees receive proper training and instructions to perform assigned job duties.

Critical Competencies
• Safety Awareness- Ability to recognize, understand, and adhere to safety protocols and procedures in the workplace; proactive in identifying potential hazards, taking steps to mitigate risks, and ensuring that both personal and collective safety are maintained in all tasks and environments.
• Leadership Skills: Acts decisively and supports all aspects of the company to work together to accomplish objectives, vision, mission and values of Vulcan. Trusts and allows people to do their job, holding them accountable for the full extent of their responsibilities.
• Planning and Scheduling: Effective planning of repair procedures, scheduling work considering resource availability, and maintaining necessary inventory.
• Processing Knowledge- Understands the material flow, crushing, screening and stockpiling process of an aggregate operation. Understands how to adjust plant settings for optimal production efficiency and troubleshoot inefficiencies.
• Communication- Communicates clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, while actively listening and adapting the message to the audience.
• Financial acumen - Understanding the meaning and implications of key financial indicators. Applying financial analysis to generate, evaluate, and act on strategic options and opportunities. Integrating quantitative and qualitative information to make better business decisions and draw accurate conclusions.

Experience
• Minimum of 5 years prior work experience in supervising production employees preferably at either an aggregate, sand/gravel or asphalt plant. Construction materials industry experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Knowledge and understanding of modern principles and practices of supervising production employees
• Thorough working knowledge of plant operation (aggregate, asphalt, ready mix) and its associated products, processes and related equipment.
• Knowledge of safety and environmental rules and regulations (MSHA and OSHA).
• Knowledge and understanding of business planning and financial forecasting requirements.
• Knowledge of drilling and blasting.
• Excellent leadership, communication, organization, conflict resolution skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Google, Oracle Business Environment and other software packages relevant to the position.
• Ability to plan and manage effectively using motivation and team building skills.
• Good organization skills, excellent problem solving skills and practices.
• Flexible to work long hours and travel when needed.
• Must represent Vulcan in a professional manner to all customers, vendors, and internal employees.

Other Requirements
• Must have the ability to lift 50 pounds and to stand, sit and walk for long periods of time.
• Must have the ability to drive a pick-up truck on a daily basis.
• Overnight travel may be required.
• Requires use of computerized equipment and technology.
• Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Position requires ability to work at multiple sites depending on business needs.
• Ability to work in a stressful, deadline oriented environment that requires complex, technical information and decision making.
• Must be able to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
• Work environment will be both indoors in an office and outside in the quarry or plant.
• Employee will perform activities at various heights, around moving machinery, be exposed to dust, fumes and gases; may be required to use hand tools or power tools.
• Outside setting will expose employee to changes in temperature/humidity and will require walking on uneven surfaces.
• Will be required to climb steps, stoop, bend, squat, kneel, crawl or reach above shoulders to accomplish functions of job.
• Position will require ability to operate automobile within plant site as well as on the open road.

JD Disclaimer
Vulcan Materials Company is an equal opportunity employer.
The Operations Manager position is an elite management role for high tonnage operations with enhanced incentive and leadership opportunity.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Internship- Strategic Sourcing (Atlanta, GA)
jobs.description:
Job Summary
We are hiring a Strategic Sourcing Intern for the Procurement team. As a Strategic Sourcing Intern, you will be exposed to the business and provided with hands-on projects and experiences, such as working on 7-step sourcing projects, using data and analytics to support decision-making for the business. In this role, you will work directly with various stakeholder departments to help drive value generation for the larger organization.
Essential Functions
• Assist with various tasks and projects assigned by supervisor and team members.
• Conduct research and gather data to support ongoing projects or initiatives.
• Collaborate with team members to develop and implement strategies.
• Participate in team meetings and provide input or suggestions as appropriate.
• Support the development and maintenance of databases, spreadsheets, and other relevant tools.
• Adhere to company policy.
• Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
• Seek opportunities to learn and grow in field of interest.
• Complete assigned tasks safely, efficiently ad within specified deadlines.
• May perform administrative duties such as filing, data entry, and organizing documents.
• Attend/complete training as needed to enhance skills and knowledge.
• Other duties as assigned.

Critical Competencies
• Communication - Communicates clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, while actively listening and adapting the message to the audience.
• Team Player - Works cooperatively and effectively with team members to achieve shared goals, willingly assisting others and fostering a positive and productive team environment. Treats other employees or customers with courtesy, dignity and respect.
• Interpersonal Savvy - Engages openly and comfortably with diverse groups, demonstrating tact, sensitivity, and consideration to ease interpersonal situations. Quickly establishes rapport and fosters positive connections.
• Work Ethic - Committed to high-quality work, demonstrating professionalism, integrity, and personal responsibility in fulfilling job duties.
• Commitment to Learning: Applies intellect to the fullest, welcoming activities that require one to stretch.
• Adaptability - Adapts to new conditions, is flexible and open-minded when facing challenges, and maintains high performance during change.

Education
• Must be currently enrolled and be in good standing with their College/University and be pursuing a degree in a related field to the internship.
• Junior or Senior level is preferred.

Experience
• Previous work experience is a plus but is not required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Knowledge of Data warehouse technology, visualization solutions like Tableau, ingestion technologies, SQL, Python, and other similar technologies.
• Excellent computer skills and experience utilizing Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and Google Mail.
• Good oral and written communication skills as well as excellent interpersonal skills.
• Should demonstrate tenacity and the ability to work on teams, take instruction, the desire for learning all areas of the work involved.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills
• Motivated, self-starter; Ability to work independently without direct supervision and as part of a team well.
• Adaptability and willingness to take on new challenges.
• Able to relate to all levels of people

Other Requirements
• Some travel may be required. May require driving between operating locations.
• May involve exposure to dust, dirt and noise.
• May work in an office setting and that requires sitting/standing for extended periods of time.
• If in an operations setting must have the ability to lift 50 pounds and to stand, sit and walk for long periods of time.
• Requires the use of computerized equipment and technology.
• This position requires knowledge and awareness of site hazards. Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Google, Oracle Business Environment and other software packages relevant to the position.
• Weekly meetings of Google meet with other interns with Division Training Manager.
• Prepare a presentation summarizing their training near the end of the program to be given in front of Managers/Supervisor, HR and other interns.

Vulcan Materials Company is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Operations Management Development Program
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Operations Management Development Program is an approximate four-year track designed to prepare candidates for a Plant Manager role. The actual duration of the program depends on individual experience and performance. Throughout the program, candidates will start with limited supervisory duties and take on larger leadership roles and responsibilities as you progress through checkpoints. Throughout the program you may be expected to work at different operations facilities. Additionally, the role will include travel to expose candidates.
What You Will Do & Learn
● Project Ownership: Candidates will have full responsibility of an operations based project in their first 6 months. Candidates are expected to deliver positive business results, and present their experience to leadership.
● Hands-on Technical Training: Gain deep exposure to core mining and aggregate processing operations, including Quality Control, Plant Maintenance, Mobile Equipment Maintenance, Drilling & Blasting, Loading & Hauling, and Engineering. Candidates will also spend extensive time on-site at one or more plants to master facility management.
● Business & Leadership Development: Participate in dedicated management training to develop proficiency in operational planning, resource allocation, and personnel management. Gain high-level exposure to essential business administration functions, including Budgeting, Finance, Sales, Human Resources, and Safety & Health.
● Career Trajectory & Compensation: This role features a structured, milestone-driven pathway toward operations management. As you successfully fulfill the requirements of each milestone and demonstrate readiness for advancement, your operational responsibilities and compensation will scale accordingly.
 0-6 Months: Supervisor – OMD (Project management)
 6 Months-1 Year: Supervisor – OMD (Limited supervisory role)
 1 Year-2 Years: Supervisor – OMD (Increased supervisory responsibilities)
 2-4 Years: Asst Plant Manager to Plant Manager

Essential Functions
• Work Coordination: Assist in planning schedules and assigning tasks to meet daily operational goals.
• Personnel Support: Support management with performance reviews, employee relations, and general staffing recommendations.
• Training Support: Help facilitate or coordinate employee training regarding standard work and safety procedures.
• Operational Optimization: Learn to analyze production, pit, and plant data to support resource optimization and efficiency strategies.
• Resource & Inventory Management: Understand critical inventory strategies to support operational decision-making.
• Commercial Support: Collaborate with commercial and sales teams to understand market demands and support customer fulfillment requirements.
• Compliance Monitoring: Participate in company Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) programs to assist with regulatory compliance, permits, and site inspection protocols.
• Operational Progression: Learn facility operations from the ground up while advancing through progressive leadership roles.
• Leadership Training: Participate in designated development programs to build technical, management, and leadership skills.
• Project Management: Coordinate and support assigned special projects as needed.
• Relationship Building: Maintain positive, cooperative working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and local community stakeholders.
• Information Management: Maintain required operational records and documentation using internal systems.

Critical Competencies
• Team Leadership & Development: Ability to build cohesive, productive site teams by aligning individual strengths with plant operational goals.
• Collaboration & Respect: Drives a cooperative culture by fostering open communication, active listening, and mutual respect among diverse crews and departments.
• Effective Communication: Conveys operational goals and safety messages with clarity and confidence, ensuring impact and credibility across internal teams and external partners.
• Driving Operational Purpose: Promotes performance excellence and personal engagement by connecting daily plant goals to the company's broader vision and values.
• Safety & Environmental Stewardship: Commitment to upholding workplace safety culture and environmental compliance through active hazard awareness, risk mitigation, and team engagement.
• Operational & Tactical Vision: Gaining insight into industry trends and operational efficiencies to support long-term plant value and sustainable workflows.

Education
• A Bachelor’s degree is preferred but not required.
• A major in Engineering, Business Administration, or Construction Management is preferred but not required.
• High school diploma or GED required.

Experience
• Industry or related experience is helpful.
• General knowledge of business and organization practices.
• Previous intern position in construction related industry.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Professional Communication: Ability to listen actively and communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing, across all levels of the organization.
• Relationship Building: Strong interpersonal skills to build positive, collaborative working relationships with diverse teams.
• Information Literacy: Ability to read, interpret, and process work-related documents, data, and reports.
• Leadership Skills: Motivate and influence others to achieve a shared goal, while demonstrating effective decision making skills.
• Critical Thinking: Ability to use logic and reasoning to solve operational problems and evaluate potential solutions.
• Decision Making: Strong judgment to evaluate options and make well-informed, safe decisions.
• Aptitude for Learning: A self-motivated learner with the ability to quickly grasp and apply new technical and operational concepts.
• Time Management: Strong organizational skills to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Adaptability & Resilience: Ability to multi-task and maintain composure in a high-pressure, industrial work environment.
• Practical proficiency with standard computer systems, business software (e.g., Google Workspace), and enterprise operational applications.

Other Requirements
• Geographical Mobility: Willingness and flexibility to relocate within the designated region during or upon completion of the training program.
• Travel Flexibility: Ability to travel occasionally, including overnight stays, to participate in or support various training, development, and operational needs. This will entail about 10% of your time in this role.
• Environmental Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in an outdoor, heavy industrial environment under varying weather conditions and within active production settings. This includes but is not limited to working outside in all types of weather, elevated work areas, loud noises, and bright lights.
• Ergonomics: Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. Able to bend, twist, kneel, squat, and get into tight spaces.

JD Disclaimer
Vulcan Materials Company is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Build Your Career. Build America’s Future.
Vulcan Materials Company is the nation’s largest producer of construction aggregates and a major producer of aggregates-based construction materials including asphalt and ready-mixed concrete. When you join Vulcan, it’s ore than starting an exciting career – you get to make a difference for millions of people every day across the country. When you join Vulcan, you join a dynamic culture in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is valued. No matter the role or the location across the country, every member of the Vulcan team lives through the Vulcan Way:  doing the right thing, the right way, at the right time .

What You’ll Do:

Summary Description of Position
Serve as a business partner to operations and sales management to enhance the Western Division’s (California) capability to achieve its goals and objectives for Southern California, (up to 10 locations) with coverage from Escondido to Chula Vista. This position has full generalist responsibilities with an emphasis on employee and labor relations. The role is supported administratively through the regional office Human Resources. Provides support for the effective execution of business initiatives, corporate and divisional policies, human resources processes and projects, and employment laws.

Essential Functions
Advises and consults with regional leadership, managers and supervisors to identify obstacles and issues to improve organization effectiveness, and develops strategies to remove those obstacles and concerns. Position works with managers on ways to improve their effectiveness through a variety of techniques and strategies.
- Position is mostly a field based role, with a majority of the role being performed in and around up to 10 locations in Southern California.

- Participates  as a member of the Division’s leadership team and leadership team planning initiatives.

- Influences and helps lead change as required by new company and division initiatives.

- Partners with regional leadership, plant managers on preventing but also solving employee relations opportunities and challenges.

- Assists with new acquisitions and growth initiatives as they relate to human resources and  organization issues.

- Partners with hiring managers throughout the interview process, participating in candidate interviews to provide objective HR-driven feedback while coaching managers on interview best practices, compliance, and effective evaluation techniques.

- Identifies issues and concerns to address employee satisfactions and develops strategies and interventions to increase employee satisfaction throughout the Division.

- Reviews and recommends strategies and new concepts to reward and recognize performance of teams and people within the Division.

- Supports managers in developing succession planning strategies and improving the talent pool throughout the Division. Identifies back-up candidates to key positions in the Division and serves as corporate contact on internal candidates in the Division.

- Identifies new technologies and "best practices" to enable the Division to reduce costs and improve productivity through better utilization of human assets and resources.

- Represents the Division on assigned Company-wide project teams.

- Effectively utilizes prevailing technologies (e.g. UKG, Oracle, Peoplesoft, etc.) to execute assigned responsibilities more effectively.

- Manages collective bargaining agreement administration, including contract interpretation, grievance processing, and dispute resolution, with HR Manager and Labor Relations Manager collaboration and support.

- Conducts regular labor relations training for management and supervisors to ensure consistent application of company policies and collective bargaining agreements.

- Serves as a point of contact for union representatives, fostering professional and collaborative labor-management relationships.

- Supports labor contract negotiations through data gathering, preparation of proposals, and participation in bargaining sessions.

Other Requirements
- Estimated travel requirement is 75 to 80%. Mostly day travel with overnight stays being very limited.

- A successful candidate will be a team oriented individual that demonstrates a “humble but
hungry” approach in how they approach all facets of their responsibilities. Open to constant change and a strong ability to adapt.

Skills You’ll Need:
Education. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Administration or related field or equivalent work experience is desired. Advanced degree is an advantage. SPHR or equivalent professional certifications preferred
Experience. Position requires a minimum of 5 years experience in a Human Resources or Organization Development career track. Two plus years of experience in labor contract negotiations and contract administration/grievance handling is required. Experience in an industrial environment is preferred. Working knowledge of heavy industrial business is an advantage.
Knowledge of Best Practices.  General knowledge of EEO, FLSA, OFCCP laws and regulations. Understanding of employment laws, rules and regulations. Knowledge and understanding of employee relations.
Integrity and Decision-Making.  Unquestioned personal and professional integrity.
Leadership and Management Skills. Able to establish credibility and influence leadership.
Interpersonal Skills.  Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and interact well with all levels of personnel. Oral and written communication skills to include effective listening.
Technology Skills.  Must have the ability to use computerized equipment and technology. Must demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google, Oracle Business Environment, and other software packages relevant to the position.

Other Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
- Assertiveness – Possess the courage to take a position, even if unpopular.

- Consensus builder where and when appropriate.

- Creative problem solver and agent of change in the organization.

-  Insightful and possessing sound business judgment.

- Conflict resolution skills and the ability to constructively confront delicate issues.

- Diagnose organizational and employee issues which impact performance and organizational effectiveness.

- Develop communication programs designed to get employee commitment and support for company goals and objectives.

- Dispute resolution abilities.

- Solid presentation skills.

- Effectively understand and interface with people from different cultures and backgrounds.

- Lead and message Diversity and Inclusion importance.

- Understanding of individual and group reward and recognition strategies to motivate people towards higher productivity.

- Bilingual preferred

What You’ll Like About Us :
Great Company Culture.  Our people share a competitive drive for  excellence in an environment of trust, teamwork, open-mindedness and communication.
Safe.  Industry leader in health and safety standards.  We are committed to creating a safe work environment and protecting all employees and customers.
Meaningful Work.  What sets up apart is the work we do impacts daily lives – and every employee contributes.   Our aggregates produced are used to build roads, schools, hospitals, airports, and housing  throughout the United States .
Health Benefits.  Medical, Dental, Vision programs,  plus much more .
Rest and Relaxation.  Paid vacation, personal floating days, and paid holidays.
Prepare for the Future.  401(k) with company match and contribution.
Training and Development.  We see  our development programs and helping our employees meet their goals as a
key part of our business.
Salary Range: the base salary range for this role is between $115,000 to $130,000 annual salary . This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package.  When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors, including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

jobs.title: Senior HR Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager of Human Resources is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the human resources department within an assigned area. This may include recruitment, training, employee relations, benefits administration, performance management, and compliance with employment laws and regulations. The Senior Manager of Human Resources typically supervises a team of HR professionals and works closely with senior management to develop and implement HR strategies that support the organization's goals and objectives. Additionally, they may be responsible for developing and implementing policies and procedures related to employee relations and ensuring a positive and productive work environment for all employees.
Essential Functions
• Fully understands all aspects of the operations within their assigned area of responsibility.
• Supports recruitment and selection processes to ensure competent and capable new hires.
• Supports the effective implementation and monitoring of the Division’s EEO plans and policies.
• Investigates employee complaints and works with management to achieve an acceptable resolution.
• Facilitates one-on-one employee interviews and communicates employee comments and employment issues to members of management as is appropriate.
• Acts as a change agent, facilitating changes as required by new initiatives.
• Works with managers and supervisors to identify obstacles and issues to improve organization effectiveness and develops strategies to remove those obstacles and concerns. Works with managers on ways to improve their managerial effectiveness through a variety of techniques and strategies.
• Identifies areas and concerns over management and technical staffing requirements to meet business plans and strengthen management and human resources in the Division.
• Identifies issues and concerns to address employee satisfactions and develops strategies and interventions to increase employee satisfaction..
• Develops strategies to measure employee and team performance and effectiveness in meeting or exceeding their goals and objectives.
• Reviews and recommends strategies and new concepts to reward and recognize performance of teams and people within the Division.
• Advises managers and supervisors on strategies and solutions to a wide variety of organizational problems and concerns.
• Assists managers with succession planning and talent pool development; identifies key position backups and serves as corporate contact for internal candidates.
• Advises managers on strategies and techniques to develop people (technical and management skills) in the organization.
• Assumes employee relations responsibilities to assist employees and managers on problem solving.
• Assumes project leadership on a variety of Human Resources programs focusing on organization effectiveness.
• Works with managers and supervisors on annual salaried planning program to ensure employees are rewarded for performance and contributions.
Critical Competencies
• Conflict Resolution - Effectively addresses and resolves conflicts; identifies sources, understands perspectives, and facilitates fair, constructive solutions aligned with organizational goals maintains a positive environment, prevents escalation, and promotes collaboration.
• Leadership Skills - Acts decisively and supports all aspects of the company to work together to accomplish objectives, vision, mission and values of Vulcan. Trusts and allows people to do their job, holding them accountable for the full extent of their responsibilities.
• Customer Focus - Builds positive customer relationships and gains trust and respect, prioritizing their needs and using feedback to improve products and services.
• Problem Solving - Identify, analyze, and resolve work-related issues efficiently and effectively using practical knowledge, experience, and hands-on skills. Finds practical solutions, implements fixes, and adapts to unexpected challenges.
• Personal Accountability - Honoring your commitments to yourself and others. Acknowledging and correcting your own mistakes. Taking full ownership to address and fix problems vs. deflecting blame to others.

Education
• Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field or equivalent work experience is required.
• HR certification is preferred.
Experience
• 7 plus years of progressive responsibilities of Human Resources
• Some working knowledge of aggregate business is an advantage.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• General knowledge of EEO, FLSA, OFCCP laws and regulations.
• Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interact with all levels of the organization.
• Oral and written communication skills to include effective listening.
• Unquestioned personal and professional integrity and the ability to establish credibility.
• Possess the courage to take a position, even if unpopular.
• Consensus builder where and when appropriate.
• Creative problem solver and agent of change in the organization.
• Insightful and possessing sound business judgment.
• Conflict resolution skills and the ability to constructively confront delicate issues.
• Diagnose organizational and employee issues which impact performance and organization effectiveness.
• Develop communication programs designed to get employee commitment and support for Company goals and objectives.
• Understanding of employment laws, rules and regulations.
• Effectively interface with all levels of people in the organization; knowledge and understanding of employee relations; dispute resolution abilities.
• Superior presentation skills.
• Effectively understand and interface with people from different cultures and backgrounds.
• Understanding of individual and group reward and recognition strategies to motivate people towards higher productivity.
Other Requirements
• Effectively utilizes prevailing technologies to execute assigned responsibilities more effectively.
• Assists with new acquisitions and growth initiatives as they relate to human resources and organization issues.
• Represents the Division on assigned Company-wide project teams.
• Coordinate with the Legal Department on labor and employee relation issues to ensure legal compliance in any, and all, situations.
• Overnight travel may be required.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist
jobs.description:
Build Your Career. Build America’s Future.
Vulcan Materials Company is the nation’s largest producer of construction aggregates and a major producer of aggregates-based construction materials including asphalt and ready-mixed concrete. When you join Vulcan, it’s more than starting an exciting career – you get to make a difference for millions of people every day across the country.  When you join Vulcan, you join a dynamic culture in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded and diversity is valued. No matter the role or the location across the country, every member of the Vulcan team lives through the Vulcan Way:  doing the right thing, the right way, at the right time .
What You’ll Do:
Collaborate.  Advise managers and supervisors on day-to-day human resources issues relating to area of responsibility.  Work closely with various levels of management on employee communication issues and concerns.  Maintain a strong field presence at the plants.  Collaborate with the Recruiting Department, other divisional staff, and hiring managers to plan and execute recruiting strategies on a local level.
Champion Continuous Improvement.  Assist in the preparation and communication of the area’s initiatives. Assist with new acquisitions and growth initiatives as they relate to human resources and organizational issues. Advise Manager, Director or Vice President of Human Resources on issues to improve HR functions for assigned area.
Provide Support.  Assist employees/retirees with issues relating to employee benefits. Manage various leave programs such as personal leave, STD, LTD, and FMLA.  Advise employees and managers on leave of absence policies and procedures. Answer employee requests for HR assistance of various programs.
Execute Administrative Responsibilities.  Ensure assigned HR administrative responsibilities and tasks are executed accurately and timely (e.g. hiring, termination, and job information changes).
Manage Paperwork.  Ensure that all HR related records (e.g. personnel, medical, D.O.T., payroll) are properly maintained in compliance with record retention guidelines. Ensure all payroll activity is submitted to corporate for timely payroll processing. Ensure up-to-date procedural documentation of assigned processes and procedures.
Additional Responsibilities. Other duties as assigned.

Skills You’ll Need:
Education.  Must have a BA/BS degree, preferably in human resources, business, psychology, or a related field. PHR or SPHR certification is preferred.
Experience.  Previous experience as an HR generalist. Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment is desired. Experience in HRIS, compensation, benefits, and payroll is preferred. Supervisory experience is preferred.
Technology Skills.  Must be fluent in the use of prevailing technologies (e.g. Kronos, Taleo, PeopleSoft, Excel, Google Sheets)
HR Knowledge.  Must have a general knowledge and understanding of current HR policies and practices. Must have knowledge of multiple human resource disciplines, including compensation practices, benefit administration, recruiting, payroll, employee relations, performance management, and federal and state respective employment laws.
Interpersonal Skills.  Must have strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact with all levels of the organization. Must have strong oral and written communication skills to include effective listening. Must have good dispute resolution skills. Must have strong presentation skills. Must be able to establish and maintain credibility. Must be able to constructively confront delicate issues.
Problem Solving Skills.  Must have the ability to creatively solve problems and be an agent of change. Must possess insightful and reasonable business judgment.
Integrity.  Must have the ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and work with highly sensitive data and information.
What You’ll Like About Us :
Great Company Culture.  Our people share a competitive drive for   excellence in an environment of trust, teamwork, open-mindedness and communication.
Safe.  Industry leader in health and safety standards.   We are committed to creating a safe work environment and protecting all employees and customers.
Meaningful Work.  What sets up apart is the work we do impacts daily lives – and every employee contributes.   Our aggregates produced are used to build roads, schools, hospitals, airports, and housing   throughout the United States .
Health Benefits.  Medical, Dental, Vision programs,   plus much more .
Rest and Relaxation.  Paid vacation, personal floating days, and paid holidays.
Prepare for the Future.  401(k) with company match and contribution.
Training and Development.  We see   our development programs and helping our employees meet their goals as a key part of our business.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Internship- Leadership Development
jobs.description:
Job Summary
Under general supervision, this position will provide support for the Organizational Development Department. This department is tasked with serving as a resource to the corporate and divisional offices in the areas of organizational development, talent management, training, and human resources.
Support may include, but is not limited to, designing and editing instructional content, working with subject matters experts (SMEs) on course development, assisting with the implementation and support of training programs, as well as data analysis and reporting.

Essential Functions
• Designing and editing leadership development instructional content alongside Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
• Assisting with the implementation and support of various training programs.
• Developing training-related surveys and conducting analysis.
• Assisting in the development and implementation of training reinforcement content.
• Assisting in scripting, filming, and editing videos to support training modules.
• Taking classroom instructional content and building interactive modules to be loaded into the LMS.
• Assisting in the development of organizational communications.

Critical Competencies

Education

Experience

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Should demonstrate tenacity and the ability to work on teams, take instruction, the desire for learning all areas of the work involved.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills
• Motivated, self-starter; Ability to work independently without direct supervision and as part of a team well.
• Adaptability and willingness to take on new challenges.
• Able to relate to all levels of people

Other Requirements
• Some travel may be required. May require driving between operating locations.
